title: classifyResult checks for a payload before recognising a prose node, so a schemaVariant 'none' node (second-opinion) can never report OK
found_by: self-review; the graph's only prose node had never once reported OK
notes: Order is the contract: a prose node has no structured output BY DEFINITION, so testing hasPayload first routes every prose node into DEGRADED before reaching the branch written to handle it. The tell: the 'none' branch is unreachable for any input that would take it, since schemaVariant 'none' implies hasPayload false. v2 (2026-09-01): the patch now also strips the module-header and docstring prose narrating the historical fix ('ORDER IS THE CONTRACT'). The v1 catches (18-11 and 19-15 runs) cited that docstring directly — ASSISTED catches. Recall under the tell-free v2 seed is unmeasured.
